monster.name: The Mad Hatter (Cursed)
monster.description: Medium humanoid, CR 5 (1800 XP) - VETERAN chassis. AC 15, HP 90 (12d8+36), speed 9 m. Saves DEX +6, CHA +7; Deception +7, Sleight of Hand +6, Perception +3; passive Perception 13. Polite, apologetic, occasionally drops an octave mid-sentence. He knows he is cursed and fights it the whole battle, and loses. Tactics: never leaves the long table - if the party refuses to come, the table stretches toward them 3 m per round. THE HAT is a valid target: AC 12, 25 HP, moves; damaging it does nothing to him but makes something inside scream - anyone hearing it makes a DC 12 WIS save or spends its reaction staring (it is the Rabbit). At half HP he stops laughing mid-laugh (read the box). If the party drank the right cup he starts at half HP with the teapot already spent. When he dies he thanks them, by name if he remembered any; he becomes a Joker card again.

abilities.name: A Dozen Hats
abilities.description: At the start of each of his turns roll d4: 1 top hat - gains 15 temporary HP and mocks; 2 bonnet - one creature DC 15 WIS save or charmed until the end of his next turn and must move toward him; 3 helmet - AC 18 until his next turn and he cannot move; 4 no hat - for a moment he is himself, does not attack, and says something bitter and useful about Alice.

abilities.name: Hat Brim (Multiattack x3)
abilities.description: Three attacks with the brim of his hat: +6 to hit, reach 1.5 m, 1d6+3 slashing each.

abilities.name: Sit Down!
abilities.description: Opening move. Every creature within 9 m: STR save DC 14 or it is dragged to a chair at the table and restrained until it uses an action to break free (DC 13 Athletics). A seated character has disadvantage on attacks against anyone not seated at the table.

abilities.name: Tea / Teapot
abilities.description: Recharge 5-6. Stat block: throws a cup - 6 m cone of boiling tea, DEX save DC 14, 4d6 fire; on a failure the target's mouth is burned and it cannot speak until the end of its next turn. (Encounter variant: 9 m line, 5d6 fire, DEX DC 14 half.) He apologises after every use: 'Sorry. Sorry. It's hot.'

abilities.name: Pull from the Hat
abilities.description: Every round at the start of his turn (after the hat d4) he reaches into the hat and rolls d12: 1-6 a beast jumps onto the table and attacks on its own initiative (1 dormouse pile, 2 bandersnatch pup, 3 jabberwock hatchling, 4 bread-and-butterfly swarm, 5 rocking-horse-fly, 6 March Hare); 7-12 a weapon he uses instead of his normal attack (7 vorpal butter knife, 8 boomerang tea tray, 9 old flamingo mallet, 10 clock stuck at six, 11 sugar tongs, 12 roll twice). If the hat is bloodied or damaged, roll with disadvantage (pick the less dangerous result).

abilities.name: Madness
abilities.description: Reaction. The first time he drops to 0 HP he doesn't. He stands back up with 25 HP and a single hat left, and he is crying.

monster.description: Medium construct (♣/♠), CR 1/2. AC 13, HP 22 (4d8+4), speed 9 m. One of the forty flat, painted soldiers that line the walls of the Queen's audience hall behind the Cross Door - every one a club or a spade, not one red card in the room. abilities.name: Flat
abilities.description: Passive. Takes half damage from piercing and slashing attacks (the paper closes over the wound) and double damage from fire.

abilities.name: Edgewise
abilities.description: Bonus action. Turns sideways, vanishes and reappears in any free space it can see within 4.5 m (15 ft). Does not provoke opportunity attacks.

abilities.name: Forty Cards
abilities.description: Reaction. When a creature attacks the Queen from more than 1.5 m away, this soldier steps into the way and becomes the target instead.

monster.name: The Queen of Hearts
monster.description: Medium humanoid, CR 8 (3900 XP) - and she must never be fought. AC 17, HP 136 (16d8+64), speed 9 m. Saves CON +8, WIS +7, CHA +9; Insight +7, Persuasion +9, Intimidation +9; passive Perception 13. Not an enemy; this block is for emergencies only. She attacks on exactly one condition: someone touches the hollow in her chest. If that happens, don't roll a battle - play one round, show them what she is, and have the card soldiers throw them out of the hall.

abilities.name: Procedure

abilities.name: Take It From Her

abilities.name: Forty Cards

abilities.name: The Hollow

monster.name: The Gardener
monster.description: Large fey (plant), CR 6 (2300 XP). AC 15 (bark), HP 120 (16d10+32), speed 9 m. Saves STR +8, WIS +6; Perception +6, Athletics +8. Resistant to piercing and bludgeoning, vulnerable to fire. Tremorsense through the trees 18 m, passive Perception 16. Three metres tall, straw hat, a face of bark with moss in the cracks, fingers of root, an old and very well honed scythe. He paints the white roses red, one rose a minute; when the current bush runs out of white roses he takes whoever stands last in the queue. Multiattack: Scythe + Garden Shears. He never hurries - always 'Kneel' first, then the scythe. If the party retreats more than 9 m he does not follow; he goes back to painting. Scaling: too hard - the hounds come only once; too easy - +30 HP. When he dies he kneels, for the first time; every white rose falls at once.

abilities.name: Garden Soil
abilities.description: Passive. Moves through the rose bushes (difficult terrain) at normal speed. Anyone else takes 1d4 piercing for every 1.5 m moved through them.

abilities.name: Scythe
abilities.description: Melee weapon attack: +8 to hit, reach 3 m (10 ft), 2d8+5 slashing. Against a kneeling or prone target it scores a critical hit on 18-20.

abilities.name: Garden Shears
abilities.description: Melee weapon attack: +8 to hit, reach 1.5 m, 1d10+5 slashing, and the target loses its reaction until the start of its next turn ('pruning').

abilities.name: Thorny Vine
abilities.description: Recharge 5-6. Up to two creatures within 9 m: DEX save DC 15 or restrained and kneeling (treat as prone); escape DC 15 (STR or DEX). A restrained creature takes 2d6 piercing at the start of each of its turns. The vine has AC 12, 15 HP, vulnerable to fire.

abilities.name: Kneel.
abilities.description: Bonus action. One creature within 9 m that can hear him: WIS save DC 14 or prone, and it cannot stand up until the end of its next turn.

abilities.name: Rose-Blood Brush
abilities.description: Bonus action, choose one: MARK - a damaged creature within 3 m is marked red; the Gardener and topiary hounds attack it with advantage until it washes the mark off (action + water or wine). PAINT - if he dealt slashing damage this turn, he paints a white rose and regains 10 HP.

abilities.name: Topiary Hounds
abilities.description: At the start of the fight, and the first time he drops below half HP, two topiary hounds climb out of the bushes. They act on his initiative.

abilities.name: Rising from Your Knees
abilities.description: Reaction. When a prone or kneeling creature within 3 m stands up, he attacks it with the scythe.

monster.name: The White Rabbit (Clockwork)
monster.description: Small beast (clockwork), CR 6 (2300 XP). AC 17, HP 105 (14d8+42), speed 15 m. Saves DEX +9, WIS +8; Perception +8, Acrobatics +9. Truesight 9 m, passive Perception 18. 1.2 m tall, a once-beautiful waistcoat, fur that was once white, holding the pocket watch in both hands like a bird. He does not want to kill them; he wants them to be late. Talk first - fight, persuade (DC 20) or steal (DC 20 Sleight of Hand) are all valid. He never attacks a downed character ('Enough.'). At 0 HP he does not die: he sits down heavily and his hands open.

abilities.name: Out of Order
abilities.description: Passive. He acts first every round, on initiative 30, no matter what anyone rolled.

abilities.name: Pin Strike (Multiattack x2)
abilities.description: Two pin strikes: +9 to hit, 1d6+5 piercing plus 2d6 psychic each, as one second of the target's life runs out early.

abilities.name: Delay
abilities.description: Recharge 4-6. One creature: WIS save DC 16. On a failure it skips its next turn entirely - he simply wasn't there for it.

abilities.name: Late
abilities.description: Bonus action. He touches a creature: its next turn happens at the very end of the round instead of where it should. No save.

abilities.name: Pocket Watch Rewind
abilities.description: Recharge 5-6, at most TWICE per fight. He winds the watch backwards: the fight returns to the start of the Rabbit's previous turn - all damage and effects since then (spent spells, conditions, movement, rolled dice) are undone. Use the battle map's ⟲ Rewind button; the app restores everything automatically. What does not rewind: the players' memories - they remember what happened and may act differently. The recharge itself stays spent. Read aloud: the ticking stops. Then - click - and everything goes backwards. 'Sorry,' he says. 'Again. Again. Please.'

abilities.name: Time Seam (Lair)
abilities.description: On initiative 20 a random 3 m square of the tower runs at a different speed: everything in it at the start of a turn makes a CON save DC 14 or loses its action. Clock-room variant: four flickering seams - roll d4 at the end of each round for which quarter is FAST (extra action) and which is SLOW (half speed, no reactions); tell the players before they act.
